papers_reviewed.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and the Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: Directly upgrades H174 PEAD signal. Speaker-weighted FinBERT on 16,428 S&P 500 transcripts (2015-2025). 46% IC improvement, 2.03%/month long-short alpha, t=6.49. Analyst turns 49%, CFO 30%. Signal half-life 6-7 days. Clean OOS 2023-2024. Addresses root cause of H168 failure (coverage bias, not concept). New hypothesis H340 proposed.

papers_reviewed.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: H316 reference paper — now has full quantitative results. Sharpe 3.791 vs cointegration 1.218. Two-stage LLM pair selection + execution on 10 US mega-caps. DeepSeek-V3.2. Pair selection is the key innovation (ablation: removing it → Sharpe -0.125). Confirms cointegration-free LLM approach is superior to H307 ETF pairs approach.

papers_reviewed.title: AlphaCrafter: A Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
papers_reviewed.relevance_notes: H318 architectural blueprint. 3-agent closed-loop: Miner (factor discovery) + Screener (regime-conditional ensemble) + Trader (risk-constrained execution). Tests on CSI 300 and S&P 500. Screener component maps directly to H318 meta-agent ETF rotation selector. Outperforms SOTA, lowest cross-trial variance.

summary: Tonight's scan found three high-relevance papers. The strongest find is arXiv:2604.13260, which provides a speaker-weighted FinBERT methodology with 46% IC improvement and 2.03%/month alpha on S&P 500 earnings calls — directly actionable as H340, a targeted upgrade to the confirmed H174 PEAD strategy. The Moira paper (2605.01954) fills a long-standing quantitative gap in H316 with concrete results (Sharpe 3.791 vs cointegration 1.218), confirming LLM pair selection — not execution — is the key innovation. AlphaCrafter (2605.05580) gives H318 a published three-agent blueprint with regime-conditional factor ensembles. No new GitHub repos require immediate integration. The quality-momentum (H337b) and cross-sectional factor (H313/H320 family) directions had no new high-signal papers this cycle.
